question: If a spell with offspring is countered, is a token created?

expected.shortAnswer: No: the offspring ability will not trigger, so no token is created.
expected.answer: If the spell is countered, the offspring ability will not trigger, and no token will be created.

whyHard: Offspring is paid as an additional cost, so players expect the token even if the spell does not resolve.
